en.title: Five beef noodle shops in Hsinchu
en.cardDesc: One bowl each at Chenghuang Temple, NTHU, Guangfu Road, Zhongzheng Road, and Zhubei — the map is what shows the distance.
en.html:
Five beef noodle shops in Hsinchu

Hsinchu beef noodle is not one street competing with itself — it is five points. Chenghuang Temple, NTHU, Guangfu Road, Zhongzheng Road, and Zhubei each get a bowl; the map is what shows the distance. All five were still open in 2026. Hours and closing days follow the shops; no prices here.

九添福牛肉麵館

九添福牛肉麵館 is at No. 436, Xida Road, North District, a few minutes' walk from 城隍廟. Still on the 2026 Bib Gourmand list. Both red-braised and clear broth; generous meat. Parking around the temple is hard — treat the shop as the pin.

璽子牛肉麵

璽子牛肉麵 main shop is at No. 31, Bo'ai Street, East District, on the municipal zoo / NTHU side. Clear broth, tendon with bite. The jinbing often sells out. Closed Tuesdays; lunch and dinner only. Zhubei and Xiangshan have branches; this piece pins the main shop.

成都老鍋牛肉麵

成都老鍋牛肉麵 is at No. 126, Sec. 2, Guangfu Road, East District — the Hsinchu Science Park / NTHU after-work axis. Sichuan-leaning but not pure heat; the bone broth cooks longer. Closed Wednesdays. Same stretch as 璽子 on Bo'ai Street, but too far to walk as one meal. Treat them as two pins.

臻穎牛肉麵食館

臻穎牛肉麵食館 is at No. 366, Zhongzheng Road, near the Air Force Hospital and Big City. Moved from Minsheng Road in 2025. Thirty-plus years of juancun taste. The Five Blessings bowl puts tendon, tendon core, pork belly, tripe, and tendon in one bowl. Closed Mondays; cars are hard to park nearby.

文化城牛肉麵

文化城牛肉麵 jumps to No. 486, Guangming 1st Road, Zhubei — not the same map scale as the four in the city. Large cuts, many small plates; iced tea refills for dine-in. Closed Thursdays. The pig's trotter often sells out; come early if you want it on the side.

Do not try all five in one day. Pick one bowl as this visit's anchor, then start the next from the other side of the map.

en.title: Yangmingshan: one night, two days on foot
en.cardDesc: Tienlai as the base. Qixing from Xiaoyoukeng; the fish trail the next day.
en.html:
Yangmingshan: one night, two days on foot

Split a holiday from a workout and the weekend becomes two jobs: one day sleeping in the car, one day forcing a climb. This time we flipped it — book 陽明山天籟渡假酒店 as the base, climb 七星山 on Saturday, walk the north stretch of the 魚路古道 on Sunday, both days from the same bed.

Why Tienlai

This is the seaward side of Yangmingshan, not the Beitou strip. 天籟 is in Jinshan. After enough Qixing sulfur on the mountain, the nose is already dull in the lobby. The north fish trail finishes toward Jinshan — toward the bed, not back into the city. Soak the legs and stop.

Saturday｜Qixing

Park at 小油坑 and start the climb to 七星山主峰 from there. Short, steep stone steps; fumaroles hiss beside you; sulfur works into the throat. The legs complain before the lungs. Wind on the summit dries the sweat; only wind left in the ears. Below: white smoke and ridgeline, not a view staged for anyone. Sit a while, then the same way down. Legs still shaking back at Tienlai; the water is the temperature that matches the day.

Sunday｜north fish trail

Day two is not a summit. Walk the fish trail — Jinbaoli Road, the old route that carried fish over the mountain. From 金包里城門 north toward Jinshan. Uneven stone steps underfoot, shade in stretches; where the soles pick up wet soil, the stride shortens on its own. At 憨丙厝地 you can stop by the stone house and catch your breath — travelers used to mend straw sandals here. Then on to 上磺溪, closer to Tienlai. Fold yesterday's steep into a path that goes home.

This Shanghuangxi stretch is a record of walking it then; it has been / may still be closed. Check Yangmingshan National Park / on-site notices before walking it again.

Map order: Tienlai → Xiaoyoukeng / Qixing → the gate / Hanbingcuodi → back to Tienlai. Two days, one sleeping coordinate.

Still to write: other north-Taiwan “one night + two days on foot,” bikes, the coast, living-water lake days off — pin those next. First piece in the resort-fitness series.

en.title: Tokyo stays: Shinagawa, Osaki, Gotanda
en.cardDesc: Three spots on the Yamanote Line, each with a different neighborhood feel.
en.html:
Tokyo stays: Shinagawa, Osaki, Gotanda

Source: Merry Journey

Shinagawa（品川）

The easiest station for Haneda — Keikyu takes about 15–20 minutes. Stay at 品川王子大飯店 — about two minutes from the station, Tokyo Tower from the high floors, pool / bowling / cinema on site.

Next door is Maxell Aqua Park, a compact aquarium with dolphin shows (the first four rows get splashed).

Osaki（大崎）

One stop down the Yamanote, plus the Rinkai Line straight to Odaiba — more of a lived-in Tokyo feel. New Otani Inn Tokyo connects to the station under cover, with rooms wider than a typical business hotel. Behind it, OAKI New City has a large supermarket (wagyu, prepared food), Daiso, and plenty to eat.

Gotanda（五反田）

Transfer to the Toei Asakusa Line for Skytree, Ginza, Nihonbashi; some trains run through to Narita. 東急 Stay 五反田 is under 10 seconds from exit A6, with a washer and microwave — useful for longer stays. A one-minute walk to a five-floor Don Quijote.
